result.title: GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes
result.summary: Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. For dynamic scenes with temporally separated input views, this mismatch places the same moving object at a different position in each input frame, so it can be rendered at an inaccurate position. While temporal encodings inform attention when a token was observed, they do not resolve where its content should be at the query time. We introduce a simple and general approach that aligns positional encodings with dynamic scene geometry through Galilean transport. Before positional encoding, each key's 3D position is transported to the query time using its estimated velocity and the temporal offset. By modifying only key positions, our method integrates directly with existing encodings, including RayRoPE and URoPE, without altering their formulations. Velocities can be obtained from arbitrary sources. By default, we estimate them from token correspondences within the network. Integrated into LVSM, our method improves dynamic view synthesis on Syn4D, dynamic Objaverse, and real-world Stereo4D videos over baselines. Ablations show that encoding velocities as token features yields smaller gains, while attention visualizations reveal that our method attends to query-time locations of moving content, unlike RayRoPE. Beyond view synthesis, our method also reduces tracking errors on dynamic objects in a pretrained 3D point tracker and improves moving-vehicle generation in a video generator.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GALILEO：在做几何位置编码前，先按估计速度与时间偏移把每个 key 的 3D 位置平移到 query 时刻，从而让 RayRoPE、URoPE 等编码适配动态场景；并在 LVSM 新视角合成、3D 点跟踪和视频生成任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文表明只改 key 的位置即可改变注意力实际对齐的内容与时刻，且给出注意力可视化，可能可供核查 LVR 中位置编码、时间偏移与注意力结构如何影响视觉证据筛选和对齐。
